category_edits.rationale: Blend 80% of the existing weighted pairwise loss with 20% uniform pairwise loss to improve ranking across valid positions using the same sampled negatives. Preserve architecture, inference, sampling, and training settings.

edits.replace:
weights = torch.softmax(valid_neg.detach(), dim=0)
    pairwise_loss = torch.nn.functional.softplus(valid_neg - valid_pos)
    existing_loss = (weights * pairwise_loss).sum()
    return 0.8 * existing_loss + 0.2 * pairwise_loss.mean()
